controlling_rule.label: predicate unlawfulness incorporation
controlling_rule.text: An operational violation is not discarded merely because its source authority lacks a standalone private remedy. The unlawful operational condition may supply falsity, deception, omission content, knowledge, materiality, transaction causation, injury nexus, public-benefit significance, and remedial necessity within an independently actionable Minnesota count. No predicate authority is miscoded as a freestanding cause of action unless a separate private right is independently authorized.
limitations: Each destination count must be independently actionable.
Omission liability must identify a legally sufficient disclosure duty.
Predicate unlawfulness does not itself establish every element of the destination count.
Allegations remain allegations until admitted or adjudicated.
